import type { TableContract, TableColumn } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Table extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        caption: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        columns: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        rows: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        sort: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        rowHeaderColumnId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        overflow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    caption: string;
    columns: readonly TableColumn[];
    rows: TableContract['rows'];
    sort: TableContract['sort'];
    rowHeaderColumnId: string | undefined;
    private overflow;
    private observer?;
    private observed;
    constructor();
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    private measure;
    get committedSort(): {
        columnId: string;
        direction: "ascending" | "descending";
    } | undefined;
    private toggle;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
